creator: Alexander Terp
description:
2026-10-17, `./dev --linux` on the laptop (main at 76c1aae5): aarch64 ran natively and passed all 860 tests; x86_64 ran under emulation and failed one, `attribution::a_pane_with_no_agent_refuses_a_report_through_a_server` (crates/muster-daemon/tests/daemon/attribution.rs:110): left ["served 0"], right ["served 1"], i.e. the report through `<fake agent> serve &` was taken where it should be refused. It fails 3 of 3 run alone under emulation, and still fails with the fake agent's shebang put back to #!/bin/sh, so it is neither load nor the dash change. The test is unchanged since 2026-10-07 (f17d3b67); nothing in that day's unpushed range touched attribution.rs.

Likely the emulator again: `./dev` already skips `the_system_reports_a_real_process_group` under emulation (EMULATED_ARGV) because qemu replaces what /proc says about a process, and recognising the fake agent's server depends on identifying the process. Not confirmed. To settle: run it on a native x86_64 Linux (CI's linux job once credits return, or the devenv); if it passes there, add it to the emulated skips in `./dev` with the reason; if it fails, it is a real bug in server_of on x86_64.
title: Under x86_64 emulation, a pane with no agent takes a report through a server
